displayDescription: Charcoal and white chalk on cool toned paper: a smudged, hatched light bulb draws lines out to hatched nodes, forming a connected system.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (offscreen layer canvases: fixed paper, paper-tooth masks, prebuilt smudge masks, per-frame charcoal value layer, separate white-chalk layer)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.0 (local gsap.min.js): one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video tweens a plain progress-state object and the caption clip-path/opacity; Canvas redraws from that state on every update and on hf-seek
audioDescription: Silent preview. No audio track, music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Procedural approximation of charcoal and chalk. Multi-pass strokes are masked by a fixed seeded paper-tooth texture. This is not a simulation of physical pigment transfer or real smudging.
Smudge and eraser effects are prebuilt blurred masks and destination-out strokes, revealed by radial and path progress.

Background changed from the earlier warm #EDE7DC swatch to cool blue-grey toned paper (#BFC4C6) under the scene-dependent policy. The medium stays monochrome: charcoal #232426, with white chalk #F3F1EA only on highlights.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json has no matched sources or contact sheets, so no source-frame techniques were applied.
No preview recipes were supplied. The preview shows the base style implementation.
Blender was not used, as instructed. Rendering and browser QA are left to the host.
